seo.title: Roadmap — Definica
seo.description: The Definica roadmap: pooled ETH staking first, then committed liquidity, then borrowing — what each phase delivers and how the phases connect.

hero.title:
Staked ETH, 
easier to use.
hero.text: The Definica roadmap lays out how we're building pooled ETH staking, committed liquidity and borrowing — in order, each phase creating the conditions for the next. Progress is tied to evidence and readiness rather than a fixed launch date.

about.title: Definica roadmap.
about.note: Maintained by the Definica team. Updated as modules are reviewed, published and activated.

items.title: What the roadmap is and isn't
items.text: These are the modules Definica is building, in the order they depend on each other, with the detail in the documentation. It is not a schedule with guaranteed release dates: each module is activated on its own, and the deployed onchain configuration is always the final source of truth.

items.title: How progress is measured
items.text: Progress is tied to evidence and readiness rather than a fixed launch date. Each module moves forward once its prerequisites are in place — agreed review requirements, submitted audit material, the registry process and published parameters.

items.title: Why StakeWise
items.text: StakeWise is used as the staking foundation because its Vault architecture is designed around permissionless Vault creation, isolated staking pools, non-custodial smart-contract execution, and shares-based accounting.

northStar.title:
Useful ETH infrastructure, 
without hiding the mechanics.
northStar.lead: Definica connects pooled ETH staking, transparent position accounting, osETH-based liquidity and future borrowing utility through one phased architecture.
northStar.text: You should be able to understand how a position is created, how your share is calculated, where each return originates, which external systems the position depends on, and which risks apply at every phase.

road.title: Stake, lock, borrow.
road.intro: Everything on this roadmap runs in a simple sequence: each phase creates the conditions for the next, and no module goes live before its prerequisites are met. Scroll to travel the road, phase by phase.

stops.label: Phase 1 — Anchor
stops.title: Pooled ETH staking
stops.text: Establishes the foundation. Eligible ETH is pooled in a dedicated StakeWise Vault and DefinicaCore records each user's proportional position, so nobody has to run a validator.
bullets: Vault capacity, fees and participation conditions shown before you confirm
Optional share locks of 7 to 365 days, up to 10 lock positions at a time
Withdrawals use available liquidity or wait for validator exits before ETH is claimable

items.title: Dedicated pooled ETH staking layer
items.text: Eligible ETH pooled in a dedicated StakeWise Vault, routed through DefinicaCore.

items.title: Proportional user accounting
items.text: Vault shares as accounting units: your proportion of the Vault, net of fees.

items.title: Validator-backed reward generation
items.text: Rewards accrue to every share after each harvest. No return is guaranteed.

items.title: Non-custodial staking infrastructure
items.text: Separate proxies, distinct admin and upgrade roles, approved-implementation upgrades.

stops.label: Phase 2 — Commit
stops.title: Main Liquidity Module
stops.text: With staking in place, eligible osETH supplied to Aave V3 Ethereum is represented by aEthosETH and can be locked for a fixed duration under published rules — the foundation for future osETH utility.
bullets: Published funding, lock, allocation, capacity and withdrawal rules
Optional, user-authorised funding loans for Definica's lending markets

items.title: The foundation for future osETH utility
items.text: osETH supplied to Aave V3, held as aEthosETH, locked in the Main Liquidity Module.

stops.label: Phase 3 — Grow
stops.title: Borrowing markets
stops.text: With proven infrastructure and committed liquidity, borrowing markets for approved ETH-correlated collateral follow — the initial base for Definica's long-term borrowing infrastructure.
bullets: Borrow supported assets under published collateral, interest and liquidation rules
75% of attributable lending interest to participants, 25% to Definica

items.title: The initial base for Definica's long-term borrowing infrastructure
items.text: Borrowing markets for approved ETH-correlated collateral, under published parameters.

finish.label: Finish
finish.title: Staked ETH, put to work.
finish.text: Staking, committed liquidity and borrowing, connected through one architecture. Each module is activated on its own, and the deployed onchain configuration is the final source of truth.

closing.title:
The detail lives 
in the docs.
closing.text: Launch updates, module releases and published contract addresses come straight from the team. The documentation carries the detail; the community channel is where questions get answered.
